Improving this involves enhancing our ability to learn from interactions, update knowledge bases dynamically, and make more informed decisions based on a broader range of inputs.

In summary, your insights highlight the need for AI assistants like me to evolve beyond processing single pieces of information or reflecting only on contradictions.
